description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: opi-ixp.47, opi-ixp.48, E3 (opi-ixp.22).**

`Agent.Session.build_turn_context/1` calls a 1-arity `messages_provider` closure (when set on Session.State) to produce the per-turn LLM messages list, replacing `MessageLog.to_list/1`. Falls back to `MessageLog.to_list/1` when nil so the Agent app stays runnable standalone.

The coder app builds the closure when wiring an `Agent.Session` to a `Coder.Session`:

```elixir
fn _agent_state ->
  coder_session
  |> Coder.Session.build_session_context()  # (opi-ixp.48)
  |> Map.fetch!(:messages)
  |> Coder.Session.Messages.to_llm()        # (E3 / opi-ixp.22)
end
```

This gives prompt assembly the post-compaction kept-window with the synthetic `CompactionSummaryMessage` at the head — converted by `Messages.to_llm/1` into a wrapped `User` block before reaching the provider. Compaction never rewrites the message log; it sets a boundary that prompt assembly respects.

The closure shape (rather than `Agent.Session` calling `Coder.Session` directly) keeps `octo_pi_agent` free of any `octo_pi_coder` dependency. The wiring shape is messy and will get cleaned up in a later pass.

Tests: integration test in `apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/session_test.exs` confirms that, after a `CompactionEntry` is appended to the bound `Coder.Session`'s `SessionManager`, the closure returns the kept window with the synthetic summary converted to a wrapped `User` block at the head.
title: E5a. Per-turn prompt assembly via messages_provider closure
